lesson.meaning: Having the duty to take care of something or someone, or being the cause of something.
examples: Who is responsible for managing the project budget this quarter?
As a team member, you are responsible for completing your tasks on time.
Parents are responsible for teaching their children good manners.
The system error was ultimately responsible for the data loss.
I feel responsible for making sure our meeting runs smoothly today.
lesson.memory_tip: Mama says: Think of the 'R' in 'responsible' as 'Reliable' – someone who can be trusted to do what's right!
